d.ko: From the creators of Before Your Eyes — You are Isaac, a 6-month-old baby, developing mysterious psychic powers. What you want most is to be loved and accepted by your family, but a secretive tech corporation wants you for their own.
d.en: From the creators of Before Your Eyes — You are Isaac, a 6-month-old baby, developing mysterious psychic powers. What you want most is to be loved and accepted by your family, but a secretive tech corporation wants you for their own.
d.zh: 你将扮演伊萨克——一名6个月大的婴儿，已经开始逐渐觉醒超能力。你想要的东西很简单，那就是家人的爱，但一家神秘的科技公司却在暗中觊觎着你。

rv.t: 돌아가신 할아버지가 남긴 책을 통해 텔레파시와 염력을 얻게 된 초능력 아기 이야기. 겉으로 보이는 것과 달리 텔레파시를 통해 타인이 무슨 생각을 하고있는지 들여다 볼 수 있는 설정이 신박합니다!!
